people.name: Bethel
people.line: Important city in Israel, associated with Abraham and Jacob.

translations.web: He called the name of that place Bethel, but the name of the city was Luz at the first.
translations.bsb: and he called that place Bethel, though previously the city had been named Luz.
translations.kjv: And he called the name of that place Bethel: but the name of that city was called Luz at the first.
translations.asv: And he called the name of that place Beth-el. But the name of the city was Luz at the first.
